threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' and not just 'the overground' when you're getting from Hackney to Dalston.
Spotted a guy on the 59 bus serenading the driver with a ukulele. Driver didn’t even flinch, just kept driving like it was normal.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy hand-rolling his cig on the bench while a toddler danced in the middle of the street - pure Neukölln magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a kebab stand with a line that’s longer than the wait for the U-Bahn, all while locals argue about the best garlic sauce.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they can name at least three taquerias that used to be something else and point out exactly when the musky smell turned into artisanal coffee.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus yesterday packed with tourists singing 'I Left My Heart in San Francisco.' Only in the TL do you see that kind of tourist charm collide with reality.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's just about the plazas and bars. They miss the quiet mornings when locals chat over a freshly baked coca in tiny bakeries.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their hesitation at crosswalks, waiting for the green man even when there’s no traffic in sight.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You walk into a cafe and ask for a 'regular coffee' — the barista just stares at you like you’ve ordered a spaceship.
Caught a guy on the 59 last night, loudly explaining how he invented a new way to eat Jollof rice. Bus was packed but everyone pretended they weren’t eavesdropping.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy juggling flaming torches outside the Kottbusser Tor U-Bahn station while a group of kids cheered him on.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can catch a silent disco tram in Kreuzberg on weekends—everyone’s dancing in their own world while rolling through the city.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their disdain for the BART's broken brakes. They won't just complain; they'll recount every overheated train story from the last decade.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a tourist struggle with the Muni map while a local, gadget-free, casually pointed to the stop. Classic SF moment—tech vs. the street smarts.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think every bar has the same tapas, but the hidden gems here serve unique dishes that locals keep secret.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still ask locals for directions to places like Parc Güell, instead of just pulling out Google Maps. It's charming, really.
